digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review-bot authentication and secret handling
propositions: The compromised GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext by uvicorn access-logs because the bot read it from the ?token= query parameter before fix 66af was deployed
Fix 66af (Gerrit 1384) moves token sourcing from query string to X-Rebar-Token header and adds TokenRedactingFilter, but is merged to main and not yet deployed to prod
Rotating the token before deploying 66af would cause the new token to be immediately re-logged in plaintext on the next webhook call, violating the runbook precondition
The GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN is a shared secret used for three purposes: Gerrit HTTP basic-auth password (outbound), inbound webhook secret (?token= or header), and container environment variable

Correct rotation requires coordinated deployment of 66af, service-user.sh execution to update Gerrit password/SSM/webhooks.config, container restart, and end-to-end verification before the token becomes valid
